app.name: removarr
auto.explain: When enabled, the automatic cycle only runs the narrow policy; it pauses itself when something is uncertain.
auto.read_once: Automatic mode and dry run are read once at startup; changing them requires a restart.
auto.resume_help: Fix the cause first, then resume. Resuming only re-enables the next cycle; it does not run anything now.
blocker.arr_hardlinks_disabled: ARR hardlinks are disabled: a copy is made and takes extra space
blocker.arr_not_upgrade_evidence: ARR gives no proof of an upgrade
blocker.audio_language_missing: An audio language would be lost
blocker.changed_since_planning: Changed since the plan was built
blocker.coverage_incomplete: Episode or file coverage is incomplete
blocker.cross_device: Source and target are on different filesystems
blocker.excluded_note: These items are excluded from plans until the blockers are gone.
blocker.import_in_progress: An ARR import is in progress
blocker.media_root_deletion: Deleting from the media root is never automatic
blocker.none: No blocker: this item can be planned.
blocker.queue_item_hides_error: A queue item hides an error
blocker.release_not_in_search: Release not found in the search results
blocker.service_not_configured: A required service is not configured
blocker.torrent_protected_state: A torrent is in a protected state
blocker.torrent_references_target: A torrent still references this item
confirm.approve_not_execute: Approving does not run anything. Execution is a separate step.
confirm.not_draft: Only a draft plan can be approved.
confirm.title: Confirm the plan
confirm.torrent_removals: Torrent tasks that will be removed (data is never deleted by qBittorrent):
confirm.type_count: Type the number of actions to confirm
confirm.type_torrent_count: Type the number of torrent tasks to confirm
confirm.unrecoverable: Old media files that cannot be recovered (acknowledge each one)
dashboard.as_of_last_scan: as observed by the last scan
dashboard.service_actions_help: A refresh only reads from the service. A rescan creates a draft plan that you still have to approve.
detail.planned_note: What stored plans do, or did, to this item. Nothing here changes anything.
empty.filtered: No item matches the current filters.
empty.history: No action has been recorded yet.
empty.no_scan: No scan has completed yet. Run a scan to list issues.
empty.plans: No plan has been created yet.
empty.stats: No data point yet. Statistics appear once plans have been executed or observed.
error.capability_disabled: This action is disabled (capability off or dry run).
error.conflict: The request conflicts with the current state.
error.plan.confirmation_mismatch: The typed confirmation does not match.
error.plan.expired: The plan expired; build a new one.
error.plan.hash_mismatch: The plan changed since it was shown; review it again.
error.plan.no_session: No completed scan allows planning yet.
error.plan.nothing_plannable: Every selected item is blocked; nothing was planned.
error.plan.selection_ignored: The selection contains ignored items; nothing was planned.
error.plan.selection_stale: The selection comes from an older scan; refresh the list.
error.plan.selection_unknown: The selection contains unknown or resolved items; nothing was planned.
error.plan.selection_wrong_category: The selection contains items of another category.
error.plan.stale: The plan no longer matches the current state; build a new one.
error.plan.unrecoverable_not_acknowledge: Every unrecoverable old file must be acknowledged.
error.plan.wrong_status: The plan is not in a state that allows this.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts; try again later.
error.state_changed: The state changed since the plan was built.
error.storage: The database is unavailable; try again later.
error.unavailable: A service is unavailable; try again later.
evidence.incomplete_text: The evidence is incomplete. The missing parts are listed below; the item stays blocked until they are known.
explain.action.not_verified: Action {index} ({kind}) ran but was not verified.
explain.caveat.btrfs_snapshots_may_retai: On btrfs, snapshots may keep deleted data on disk, so free space can grow less than expected.
explain.issues.from_older_session: The issue list comes from scan {issues_session}, not the latest scan {last_scan}.
explain.scan.stale: The last scan finished at {finished_at}, which is older than the scan interval.
export.title: Export
flash.approved: Plan approved. Nothing has run yet: execution is a separate step.
flash.ignored: Items ignored. Nothing else was changed. You can restore them from this page.
flash.job_cancel: Cancellation requested. The job stops at its next safe checkpoint.
flash.plan_created: Plan created as a draft. Nothing has been changed on disk.
flash.restored: Items restored to the issue lists.
gain.added_help: New bytes the plan would write (for example a copy instead of a hardlink).
gain.expected_help: Expected freed space (a prediction, not yet verified)
gain.logical_help: Sum of file sizes, including data that hardlinks keep on disk.
gain.observed_help: Observed free-space change on the filesystem. It can include other writers and snapshots, so it can differ from the recorded value.
gain.potential_help: Estimate of what could be reclaimed. Not guaranteed.
gain.recorded_help: Recorded after execution, counted once per removed file. Attributable to removarr.
history.caption: Recorded actions, newest first
ignore.reversible: Ignoring is reversible: items go to the Ignored tab and can be restored. Nothing is deleted.
issues.col.name: Name
issues.hidden_recent: {n} recent items are hidden (younger than {m} days).
issues.plan_note: Creating a plan changes no file. You review it, then approve it, then execute it, as three separate steps.
issues.sel_none: Nothing selected. Tick items to act on them.
issues.select_all_banner: All {n} items on this page are selected ({size}). Nothing has been done yet.
issues.select_page.one: Select the item on this page
issues.select_page.other: Select all {n} items on this page
issues.selection_readonly: This total is read only. Nothing was changed.
issues.selection_resets: Changing a filter, the sort or the page clears the selection.
issues.snapshot_of: Snapshot of the scan finished at
issues.strip: {n} on this page | {m} in this list ({size})
jobs.cancel_help: The job stops at its next safe checkpoint; an action in progress is never cut in half.
jobs.memory_note: Only active and recent jobs are listed; the list is kept in memory and is empty after a restart.
locale.label: Language
login.failed: Sign-in failed. Check your user name and password.
login.title: Sign in
login.unavailable: Sign-in is not available in this build yet; protected pages are refused.
mode.dry_run_banner: Nothing is changed on disk or in any service: every execution is simulated.
next_step.rescan_and_replan: Rescan and build a new plan
next_step.run_or_discard: Run it again or discard the plan
plan.dry_run_only: Dry run: this plan can only be simulated. Nothing is changed on disk or in any service.
plan.not_all_done: Not every action completed. See the results and the remaining steps below.
plan.preview_not_stored: Preview only: this plan is not stored and cannot be approved.
plan.remove_torrent_tasks: Also remove emptied torrent tasks (data kept by qBittorrent)
plan.simulate_help: A simulation records what would happen and changes nothing.
plan.title: Plan
plans.caption: Stored plans, newest first
problem.no_rescan: qBittorrent has no rescan command; use refresh
problem.use_level: use debug, info, warn or error
space.allocated: Allocated on disk (each file counted once)
space.not_a_promise: Potential space is an estimate. It is not what will be freed.
space.overlap_note: Excluded because another issue already counts the same files
space.potential_not_guaranteed: Potential space (estimate, not guaranteed to be recovered)
state.cancelled_text: This job was cancelled. Work already done stays done; nothing further runs.
state.incomplete_text: Some data could not be read. Items depending on it are shown with a blocker and are not planned.
state.job_failed_text: This job did not finish. Details are in the logs; the correlation is kept server side.
state.stale_text: The last scan is older than the scan interval. Values below may no longer match the disk. Run a new scan.
stats.chart_caption: Cumulative bytes per quantity. Lines differ by dash pattern and marker shape as well as colour.
stats.chart_caption_per_day: Bytes per day and quantity. Lines differ by dash pattern and marker shape as well as colour.
stats.chart_desc: One line per quantity; the table below gives the same values.
stats.intro: Each quantity is shown on its own: estimated, expected, attributable, added and observed values are never merged.
stats.totals_all_time: The totals below cover all time; the chart and tables follow the selected period.
stats.truncated: the series was cut at its maximum size
